messages:
ava.finance: Quick approval request for StrideLabs — onboarding hit infra migration delays and they incurred ~6k in overages. Sales asking for a one-off onboarding credit + short-term commit smoothing. Adding context and proposed terms below.

liam.sales: TL;DR what exactly do you need Finance to sign off on?

ava.finance: Requesting three items: 1) One-time credit of $18,000 to cover Feb overage + partial March ramp; 2) Commit smoothing — let customer spread Q2 committed units across Apr–Jun without penalty; 3) Net30 payment terms exception (their procurement needs it). Customer is about to sign a 12-mo dedicated contract (~$600k ARR).

noelle.ae: Confirming — LOI is in place, delay was our infra handoff, customer is amenable to the deal but asked for a written credit concession. If we don't do this they may pause the contract. I have the customer's email thread.

ryan.revops: From RevOps/accounting POV: credit treated as contra-revenue, needs memo + GL code (4112). We also need a short approval note for audit: who approved, amount, and business rationale. Recommend cap at $20k for non-exec approvals.

emma.cfo: I can approve conditionally: one-off credit up to $20k, commit smoothing for up to 90 days, and Net30 is fine. Conditions: attach signed LOI and a customer acceptance email to the Zendesk ticket; Sales must confirm this won't create a precedent for other accounts (brief rationale). Finance to record journal entry and keep the approval memo. Ava — please route the docs to #exec-approvals and tag me.

ava.finance: Thanks — routing to #exec-approvals now and attaching LOI + customer email. Zendesk ticket: https://zendesk.redwood/example-ticket-4321. Adding required memo. :thumbsup:

dealbot: Approval logged: CFO emma.cfo approved one-off credit <=$20,000 and commit smoothing (90 days) at 1962034880.

liam.sales: Great — I'll upload the scanned LOI and the customer's confirmation email within the hour, and add a short rationale for the sales play to avoid future ambiguity.
notes: Thread documents the finance approval flow for a one-off onboarding credit and temporary commit smoothing for a newly closed customer; includes accounting conditions and audit trail requirements.
